integrity: Explicit proof via a common finite quotient, finite-index subgroup finite generation, orbit counting formulas and an infinite-round pebble invariant.
scientific_limitations: Relative to finite genuine group actions in the named-generator unary-function language, without counting or additional predicates. Independent audit has not been performed. A more general old composition lemma may imply this sharp specialization.
title: Sharp finite-variable equivalence for finite actions of finitely generated groups
